posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
Dadpool1014:

Maybe Trust fund has something to do with the Wraith unlock. Maybe play 3 trust funds in one turn?

TheRebelYell already tried that a few posts up.

There hasn't been an unlock yet where the characters have had to do something themselves where they need to combine with another deck to accomplish. There are lots of unlocks where character X must be present and a few where another character may have to play cards or use certain powers, but there's never a case where any of the characters involved need other players to give them extra card plays or power uses. Wraith could be our first exception, but so far, any unlock requirement can be attained with the hero's own deck and doesn't require combinations.

My point is, since Wraith couldn't possibly ever play 3 Trust Funds on the same turn by herself, it likely isn't her unlock condition. Play Impromptu Invention 3 times followed by Trust Fund, that's possible because she can do that all with her own cards.

Of course, I could be totally wrong, but it's a pattern I noticed and might want to keep in mind when we're all trying for extreme conditions to test.

posts.name: QuirkyDM
posts.cooked:
UXM266:

That's a great theory, but unfortunately Visionary Unleashed, Chrono Ranger Best of Times, and Omnitton-U all require other heroes to do something. 

They do need other heroes, but those other heroes are solo acts doing their own thing in the same game. There's no interaction of the hero decks with one another, they just all need to be in the same place doing things at the same time. Otherwise, they can ignore one another. Argent Adept does need to target Dark Visionary, but he didn't need help from anyone else to pull off his objective. He did it on his own with his own deck. Unity can put out all her cards without help from any other character. Chrono-Ranger just needed Tachyon to be around.
